source: Claude agent draft (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-11-19, P5-03 batch 02 — pending user review; names follow line-shared roots, no archetype proper names

creatures.naming_note: 闕樓銅翼收在初生小牛背上。
creatures.dex_zh: 四足短壯的青銅小牛，背脊嵌著兩片小小翼板，額前護著拱門紋章。牠守在夥伴身前，等敵人貼近才用鏽蝕的刃角向前頂擊。
creatures.dex_en: This sturdy bronze calf wears tiny wing plates on its back and an arch crest on its brow. It guards the front of its group and butts close foes with a corroding horn edge.

creatures.naming_note: 闕翼半展，肩甲化作城門門楣。
creatures.dex_zh: 肩甲化成城門門楣，疊層鐵羽半展在背後。牠穩穩守在原地，拍翼將金屬碎片灑向中距離的敵群。
creatures.dex_en: Its shoulder plates form a gate lintel, and layered iron feathers half-spread behind it. It holds its ground and flings a burst of metal shards at enemies a short way off.

creatures.naming_note: 闕翼長成，整頭獸如一座王城。
creatures.dex_zh: 體型如城門巨像，額戴角冠與青銅鬚紋面甲，雙重鋼翼收在身側。牠與敵人保持距離，高拋沉重鐵砧轟擊遠方的目標。
creatures.dex_en: As large as a city gate, it wears a horned crown and a bronze bearded mask between twin steel wings. It keeps its distance and hurls a heavy anvil onto distant targets.

creatures.naming_note: 頭頂含苞的檳榔花是牠的小冠。
creatures.dex_zh: 掌心大小的翡翠細蛇，盤在枝條上，頭頂綻開一束潔白小花。牠守在夥伴身邊，遇敵便用尖細的芽刺向前戳。
creatures.dex_en: A palm-sized jade snake coils on branches with a tuft of white blossoms on its head. It stays beside its companions and pokes nearby foes with a sharp sprout.

creatures.naming_note: 花冠舒展成三瓣，身軀長成藤蛇。
creatures.dex_zh: 鱗片如棕櫚葉層層交疊，頸側展開花枝與半透明的葉片領巾。牠守在隊伍中段，甩出纏人的荊棘索，讓被纏住的敵人更難閃避。
creatures.dex_en: Palm-leaf scales overlap down its body, and a sheer leaf collar spreads around its neck. From the middle of the group it lashes out a thorn snare that makes caught foes easier to hit.

creatures.naming_note: 七重花冠高聳，蛇身化為水林巨龍。
creatures.dex_zh: 七重繁花冠高高展開，修長的身軀纏著巨樹藤蔓與水花垂帶。牠與敵人拉開距離，喚來整棵巨木砸向遠處。
creatures.dex_en: A sevenfold flower crown rises above its long body, wrapped in vines and ribbons of spray. It keeps foes at a distance and brings a whole tree crashing down on them.

creatures.naming_note: 白色小鯨捲起第一道小渦流。
creatures.dex_zh: 圓潤雪白的小鯨，額頭帶著淡淡舊傷，背鰭插著一小截磨鈍的銅叉。牠守在原地，從噴孔噴出水柱擊打眼前的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: A round, snow-white whale calf with a faint old scar and a blunted bronze barb in its fin. It holds its place and blasts foes in front of it with a jet from its blowhole.

creatures.naming_note: 疤痕交錯的白鯨拖著斷桅出海。
creatures.dex_zh: 體側布滿暗藍色的海蝕疤痕，背上拖著半截木桅與斷裂鐵叉。牠一察覺敵人便捲起暗流，沿直線猛衝過去。
creatures.dex_en: Dark blue scars cross its sides, and a broken mast and snapped irons trail from its back. It charges straight at foes on a surge of undertow.

creatures.naming_note: 巨鯨長成，白渦化作怒海漩渦。
creatures.dex_zh: 巨尾一掀便捲起咆哮的漩渦，額頭與背脊斜插著鋼叉與船桅殘骨。牠帶著整片怒濤，沿長長的直線衝向遠方的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: Its huge tail stirs a roaring whirlpool, and steel barbs and broken masts jut from its brow and back. It rides a wall of water along a long straight path into distant foes.

creatures.naming_note: 樹皮鱗下藏著小小爐火。
creatures.dex_zh: 披著厚實木皮紋甲殼的小鱷魚，甲縫透出微弱的紅光與火星。牠守在夥伴身邊，用帶火的嘴啄咬眼前的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: This little crocodile wears thick bark-patterned scales that glow red at the seams. It stays near its companions and snaps at nearby foes with a smoldering bite.

creatures.naming_note: 背上長出猴麵包樹瘤，爐火更旺。
creatures.dex_zh: 背甲隆起猴麵包樹般的圓碩樹瘤，裡頭燒著熾紅火脈。牠守在原地橫掃尾巴，揚起的灼熱灰燼會讓敵人的攻擊距離縮短。
creatures.dex_en: Rounded baobab-like burls rise on its back, glowing with red veins of fire. It holds its ground and sweeps its tail, kicking up hot ash that shortens foes' attack reach.

creatures.naming_note: 爐鱷背負立石，整頭化作火爐巨岩。
creatures.dex_zh: 背負著立石與巨樹共生的火口甲盾，深淵般的大顎含著赤紅火球。牠與敵人保持距離，把火口裡的熔焰轟向遠方。
creatures.dex_en: It carries a crater shield of standing stones and giant trees, and holds a red fireball in its deep jaws. It keeps its distance and blasts molten fire onto faraway targets.

creatures.naming_note: 石柱上的小獅，鼻尖翹起小象鼻。
creatures.dex_zh: 砂岩雕塑般的小獅獸，翹著短短的象鼻與小牙，脖子掛著蓮瓣項圈。牠一見敵人就踩著碎石滑步衝上前。
creatures.dex_en: A small lion carved from sandstone, with a short trunk, tiny tusks and a lotus-petal collar. It skates over gravel to rush at any foe it sees.

creatures.naming_note: 雙肩扛起廊柱，柱獅長成戰獸。
creatures.dex_zh: 雙肩扛著神廟石柱護甲，象鼻與利爪都是堅硬的花崗岩。牠沿著斷層騰躍撲向近處的敵人，衝擊力十足。
creatures.dex_en: Temple pillars armor its shoulders, and its trunk and claws are hard granite. It leaps along a fault line and pounces on nearby foes with great force.

creatures.naming_note: 柱獅守住整座神廟。
creatures.dex_zh: 身披蓮座與廊柱雕刻的宏偉石獸，雙重象牙如岩槍向前延伸。牠與敵人保持距離，以長牙沿直線貫穿遠處的岩脈與敵人。
creatures.dex_en: A grand stone beast carved with lotus thrones and pillars, its twin tusks stretching forward like rock lances. It keeps its distance and drives a straight line of stone through distant foes.

creatures.naming_note: 小小雙橇載著採水瓶滑出冰面。
creatures.dex_zh: 手掌大小的雙橇冰滑裝置，中央的玻璃採水瓶閃著冰藍結晶。牠貼地無聲滑行，冷不防撞向眼前的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: A palm-sized twin-runner sled carrying a glass sampling bottle that glints with blue ice. It glides silently over the ground and bumps into foes before they notice.

creatures.naming_note: 冰橇長出龍骨，成了抗冰快艇。
creatures.dex_zh: 弧形木甲船身覆滿冰晶裝甲，桅頂架著旋轉的銅製觀測儀。牠乘著浮冰沿直線衝撞敵陣。
creatures.dex_en: Its curved wooden hull is armored in ice crystals, with a spinning brass instrument atop its mast. It rides a floe straight into the enemy line.

creatures.naming_note: 冰橇長成破冰方舟。
creatures.dex_zh: 圓弧重裝船底配著巨型冰刃雪橇，甲板列滿採水柱與觀測儀。牠全速破冰，沿長長的直線衝向遠方的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: A heavy round hull rides on giant ice-blade runners, its deck lined with sampling columns and instruments. It breaks the ice at full speed along a long straight path into distant foes.

creatures.naming_note: 海霧裡的雛鳥，翼梢刻著弓弦紋。
creatures.dex_zh: 白灰絨毛的小海鳥，翼梢刻著細緻的木弓弦紋。牠順著海風貼地疾竄，一掠而過撞向身前的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: A small gray-white seabird with bowstring patterns carved into its wingtips. It skims low on the sea breeze and darts into nearby foes.

creatures.naming_note: 霧翼展開如古船橫帆。
creatures.dex_zh: 修長的雙翼像古船橫帆般展開，羽尖折射冰山的青綠霧光。牠化作氣旋利箭，沿直線俯衝穿過敵陣。
creatures.dex_en: Its long wings open like the square sails of an old ship, their tips catching green iceberg light. It dives through the enemy line like a cyclone bolt.

creatures.naming_note: 霧翼長成遮天的遠洋巨鳥。
creatures.dex_zh: 翼展遮天，羽梢拖著海霧與帆布流蘇。牠與敵人保持距離，一振翼就向遠方掀出扇形狂風。
creatures.dex_en: Its wings blot out the sky, trailing sea mist and canvas tassels. It keeps its distance and sends a fan of storm wind sweeping toward far-off foes.

creatures.naming_note: 紅沙裡的小蟲，節環帶著磁電。
creatures.dex_zh: 圓潤鮮紅的沙地幼蟲，身上的節環纏著跳動的黃色電弧。牠繞到敵人側面，一受驚就從身體放出一圈電流。
creatures.dex_en: A plump, bright red sand larva wrapped in crackling yellow arcs. It circles to a foe's flank and releases a ring of current from its body when startled.

creatures.naming_note: 赤磁幼蟲長出棘皮與雙顎。
creatures.dex_zh: 赤紅身軀布滿枯硬的棘刺，頭冠長著發電雙顎。牠守在原地張開雙顎，向前方噴出扇形的高壓電弧。
creatures.dex_en: Dry, hard thorns cover its red body, and a pair of charged jaws crowns its head. It holds its ground and sprays a fan of high-voltage arcs ahead.

creatures.naming_note: 赤磁蟲長成半潛沙浪的巨龍。
creatures.dex_zh: 龐大的赤紅蟲軀半潛在沙浪裡，背脊的磁環一節節對準遠方。牠與敵人保持距離，蓄能後轟出極長的直線電漿。
creatures.dex_en: Its huge red body half-swims through the sand while the magnetic rings on its back line up on a distant target. It keeps its distance and fires a very long straight bolt of plasma.

creatures.naming_note: 金箔小珠，繞著兩點微光旋轉。
creatures.dex_zh: 漂浮在半空的金色薄箔稜鏡，表面不時閃爍螢光點點。牠守在夥伴身邊，用光刺戳向貼近的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: A thin golden foil prism floating in midair, its surface flickering with tiny lights. It stays beside its companions and jabs approaching foes with a glint of light.

creatures.naming_note: 三重星軌環繞，箔珠成了觀測儀偶。
creatures.dex_zh: 半身人形的光學儀偶，三重星軌光環繞著肩側旋轉。牠守在原地，從胸口的金箔核心射出筆直的聚焦光槍。
creatures.dex_en: A half-body optical figure with three orbit rings turning around its shoulders. It holds its ground and fires a straight focused lance from the gold foil core in its chest.

creatures.naming_note: 箔環長成懸浮的幾何聖像。
creatures.dex_zh: 懸浮的電磁線圈托起七彩散射光扇，三重軌環高速公轉。牠與敵人保持距離，向遠方傾瀉扇形的稜鏡光束。
creatures.dex_en: Floating coils hold up a fan of rainbow light while three orbit rings spin around it. It keeps its distance and pours a wide fan of prism beams toward distant foes.

creatures.naming_note: 小駒奔跑時，頸間口簧低鳴。
creatures.dex_zh: 墨黑短毛上覆著青灰鐵斑的小馬駒，奔跑時頸側發出低沉的共鳴聲。牠繞到敵人側面，用暮色般的牙咬上去。
creatures.dex_en: A black foal with gray iron patches whose neck hums with a low resonance as it runs. It circles to a foe's flank and bites with dusk-dark fangs.

creatures.naming_note: 鐵弦駒披上重甲，蹄聲如弦。
creatures.dex_zh: 披著層疊玄鐵甲片的修長戰駒，鬃毛像結著黑霜的枝枒。牠化入薄暮，沿直線迅速穿過敵陣。
creatures.dex_en: A long-limbed warhorse in layered black iron, its mane like frost-black branches. It slips into twilight and dashes straight through the enemy line.

creatures.naming_note: 鐵弦馬長成極寒的幽影重騎。
creatures.dex_zh: 身披巨樹紋玄鐵重鎧的黑馬，蹄下踏著霜影，伴隨低沉的共鳴嘯音。牠沿長長的直線發動貫穿衝鋒，直撲遠方的敵人。
creatures.dex_en: A black horse in heavy iron armor carved with great branches, frost shadows under its hooves and a deep hum around it. It launches a piercing charge along a long straight path into distant foes.

moves.naming_note: 銅鏽般的刃角削弱金屬。
moves.desc_zh: 以鏽蝕的刃角攻擊前方近距離的敵人，並暫時降低其金屬抗性，可疊加。
moves.desc_en: Strike a foe close in front with a corroding edge, briefly lowering its metal resistance. Stacks.

moves.desc_zh: 將金屬碎片灑向中距離的目標，傷害落點周圍的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Rain metal shards on a target at mid range, damaging enemies around the impact.

moves.desc_zh: 高拋沉重鐵砧砸向遠方目標，傷害落點周圍的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Hurl a heavy anvil onto a distant target, damaging enemies around the impact.

moves.desc_zh: 以尖細的芽刺攻擊前方近距離的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Jab a sharp sprout at a foe close in front.

moves.desc_zh: 向前甩出一道荊棘索，傷害直線上的敵人並暫時降低其閃避。
moves.desc_en: Lash a thorn snare forward, damaging foes in a line and briefly lowering their evasion.

moves.desc_zh: 喚來巨木砸向遠方目標，傷害落點周圍的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Bring a giant tree down on a distant target, damaging enemies around the impact.

moves.desc_zh: 從噴孔射出水柱，攻擊前方近距離的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Blast a jet from the blowhole at a foe close in front.

moves.desc_zh: 捲起暗流沿直線向前衝刺，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Surge forward on an undertow, damaging foes along a straight path.

moves.naming_note: 帶著整片怒濤長驅直入。
moves.desc_zh: 帶著怒濤沿長直線衝刺，傷害路徑上遠近的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Charge along a long straight path on a wall of water, damaging foes in the way.

moves.desc_zh: 以帶火的嘴咬向前方近距離的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Snap at a foe close in front with a smoldering bite.

moves.desc_zh: 橫掃身前一圈的敵人，揚起的灼灰會暫時縮短其攻擊距離。
moves.desc_en: Sweep the area in front, kicking up hot ash that briefly shortens foes' attack range.

moves.desc_zh: 將熔焰轟向遠方目標，傷害落點周圍的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Blast molten fire onto a distant target, damaging enemies around the impact.

moves.desc_zh: 踩著碎石向前短距滑行衝刺，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Skate forward a short way over gravel, damaging foes in the path.

moves.naming_note: 沿著裂開的地縫騰躍撲擊。
moves.desc_zh: 沿地縫向前騰躍撲擊，傷害短距直線上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Leap along a splitting rift and pounce, damaging foes in a short line.

moves.naming_note: 長牙化作岩槍貫穿地脈。
moves.desc_zh: 以岩槍般的長牙沿長直線貫穿，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Drive a tusk-like rock lance along a long straight line, damaging foes in its path.

moves.desc_zh: 貼地向前短距滑行衝刺，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Glide a short way forward over glazed ice, damaging foes in the path.

moves.desc_zh: 乘著浮冰沿直線向前衝撞，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Ride a floe straight forward, ramming foes along the path.

moves.desc_zh: 全速破冰沿長直線衝刺，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Break through the ice at full speed along a long straight path, damaging foes in the way.

moves.desc_zh: 順著風向前短距疾竄，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Skim forward a short way on the breeze, damaging foes in the path.

moves.desc_zh: 化作氣旋沿直線向前俯衝，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Dive forward like a cyclone bolt, damaging foes along a straight path.

moves.desc_zh: 振翼向前方遠處掀出扇形狂風，傷害範圍內的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Beat great wings to send a wide fan of storm wind far ahead, damaging foes within it.

moves.desc_zh: 從身體放出一圈電流，傷害周圍近距離的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Release a ring of current from the body, damaging foes close around it.

moves.desc_zh: 向前方噴出扇形高壓電弧，傷害範圍內的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Spray a fan of high-voltage arcs ahead, damaging foes within it.

moves.naming_note: 背脊磁環排成一道砲軌。
moves.desc_zh: 蓄能後沿極長直線轟出電漿，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Charge up and fire plasma along a very long straight line, damaging foes in its path.

moves.desc_zh: 以光刺攻擊前方近距離的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Jab a glint of light at a foe close in front.

moves.desc_zh: 射出筆直的聚焦光槍，傷害直線上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Fire a straight focused beam, damaging foes in a line.

moves.desc_zh: 向前方遠處傾瀉扇形稜鏡光束，傷害範圍內的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Pour a wide fan of prism beams far ahead, damaging foes within it.

moves.desc_zh: 以暮色獠牙咬向前方近距離的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Bite a foe close in front with dusk-dark fangs.

moves.desc_zh: 化入薄暮沿直線向前疾衝，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Slip into twilight and dash forward, damaging foes along a straight path.

moves.desc_zh: 沿長直線發動貫穿衝鋒，傷害路徑上的敵人。
moves.desc_en: Launch a piercing charge along a long straight path, damaging foes in the way.

traits.naming_note: 精密齒輪讓出招更準時。
traits.desc_zh: HP 高於 80% 時，金屬主動技冷卻縮短 20%。
traits.desc_en: While HP is above 80 percent, metal skill cooldowns are 20 percent shorter.

traits.naming_note: 出招時散出的孢子滋養自身。
traits.desc_zh: 使用木屬主動技時，回復最大 HP 的 5%。
traits.desc_en: Using a wood skill restores 5 percent of max HP.

traits.desc_zh: HP 跌破 30% 時，回復最大 HP 的 12%。
traits.desc_en: When HP drops below 30 percent, restore 12 percent of max HP.

traits.desc_zh: 使用火屬主動技後 3 秒內，閃避提高 8%。
traits.desc_en: For 3 seconds after using a fire skill, evasion rises by 8 percent.

traits.naming_note: 借著崩岩之勢加快腳步。
traits.desc_zh: 使用土屬主動技後 4 秒內，移動速度提高 15%。
traits.desc_en: For 4 seconds after using an earth skill, movement speed rises by 15 percent.

traits.naming_note: 每次出招都把冰鋒磨得更利。
traits.desc_zh: 使用冰屬主動技後 4 秒內，冰屬專精提高 20。
traits.desc_en: For 4 seconds after using an ice skill, ice mastery rises by 20.

traits.naming_note: 從容翱翔時最難被捉住。
traits.desc_zh: HP 高於 75% 時，閃避提高 8%。
traits.desc_en: While HP is above 75 percent, evasion rises by 8 percent.

traits.naming_note: 電弧沿著磁環延伸得更遠。
